recipes.d: Gentle coconut stew with tofu and sweet potato
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into small even pieces.
Soften chopped onion and curry powder in a saucepan, then add the sweet potatoes and coconut milk with a little water.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender, adding cubed tofu for the last 8 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve piping hot.

recipes.d: Flaked salmon with lemony quinoa and cucumber
steps: Cook the quinoa according to the packet instructions and drain.
Cook the salmon until opaque, hot and flaking; remove skin and check for bones.
Chop cucumber and tomatoes, then combine with quinoa, lemon juice and olive oil.
Add the cooked salmon, toss gently and serve warm.

recipes.d: Spiced cauliflower in warm tortillas with yoghurt
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and chop the cauliflower into bite-sized pieces.
Coat cauliflower lightly with oil and paprika; roast until tender and browned.
Mix yoghurt with lime juice while warming the wraps.
Fill wraps with cauliflower and chopped lettuce and finish with yoghurt dressing.

recipes.d: Rich mince and aubergine tomato sauce with pasta
steps: Cook the penne according to the packet instructions.
Dice aubergine and onion and cook in a deep pan until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add mince and cook thoroughly, then add garlic and passata and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss the cooked pasta through the hot sauce and serve.

recipes.d: Tender chicken, leeks and orzo in a creamy sauce
steps: Wash and slice the leeks, then soften them in a wide pan.
Add diced chicken and cook until thoroughly cooked with no pink remaining.
Add orzo, prepared stock and enough water to simmer until the orzo is tender; stir often.
Fold in peas and cream cheese, heat until piping hot and serve.

recipes.d: Spiced pan-fried chickpeas with fresh salad
steps: Drain and dry the chickpeas, then fry with paprika and a little oil until lightly crisp and hot.
Chop cucumber and lettuce while the chickpeas cook.
Warm the wraps and spread a spoonful of yoghurt over each.
Fill with chickpeas and fresh vegetables, then roll and serve.

recipes.d: Creamy bean mash with roasted tomatoes and greens
steps: Roast cherry tomatoes with a little oil at 210°C (190°C fan) until softened.
Drain butter beans and warm with chopped garlic, rosemary and a splash of water.
Mash the beans with a fork or masher until creamy; add a little olive oil.
Wilt spinach in a pan and serve alongside the mash and roasted tomatoes.

recipes.d: Light, warming soup with tofu and mushrooms
steps: Slice the mushrooms and cube tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Bring prepared stock with grated ginger to a simmer and add mushrooms and tofu.
Cook the rice noodles according to packet instructions, adding them to the broth when suitable.
Stir in soy sauce, simmer until everything is hot and serve.

recipes.d: Lean mince in a tomato and courgette pasta sauce
steps: Cook spaghetti following the packet instructions.
Soften chopped onion and diced courgette in a pan.
Add chicken mince and cook completely, breaking it up, then add passata and basil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain spaghetti and toss with the piping-hot sauce.

recipes.d: Warm prawn rice with fresh mango and cucumber
steps: Cook rice according to the packet instructions and use while still hot.
Ensure the cooked prawns are heated through in a pan, then remove from the heat.
Dice mango and cucumber and thinly slice spring onions.
Toss rice and prawns with mango, vegetables and lime juice; serve promptly.

recipes.d: Sweet and savoury chicken, pepper and pineapple
steps: Cook rice according to the packet directions.
Dice chicken and stir-fry with grated ginger until thoroughly cooked.
Add sliced peppers and chopped pineapple and cook until the peppers soften.
Stir through soy sauce and serve over the hot rice.

recipes.d: Baked courgettes with savoury lentil filling
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and halve the courgettes lengthways, scooping out a little of each centre.
Dice the scooped flesh and cook with mushrooms and onion until softened.
Stir through drained cooked lentils and passata, then spoon into the courgette halves.
Top with cheese and bake until the courgettes are tender and the filling thoroughly hot.

recipes.d: Warm halloumi with roasted beetroot and couscous
steps: Heat oven to 210°C (190°C fan), chop the beetroot small and roast until tender.
Prepare couscous according to the packet instructions and fluff with a fork.
Slice halloumi and fry on both sides until golden and hot.
Toss couscous with spinach and lemon, then top with roasted beetroot and halloumi.

recipes.d: Crisp tofu, green edamame and sesame rice
steps: Cook rice according to the packet and cook the edamame thoroughly according to its pack.
Dice and pat dry the tofu, then fry until golden.
Slice carrots finely and cook until tender; add soy sauce and edamame to the tofu pan.
Serve over the rice and drizzle with sesame oil.

recipes.d: Oven-baked cod in a tomato and chickpea sauce
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and place chopped peppers, garlic, tomatoes and drained chickpeas in a baking dish.
Bake the vegetables for 15 minutes until starting to soften.
Nestle the cod fillets in the hot mixture and return to the oven until fish is opaque, fully cooked and flakes easily.
Serve hot, checking for any bones.

recipes.d: One-pan creamy chicken gnocchi with lemon
steps: Dice and pan-fry chicken with chopped garlic until completely cooked through.
Cook gnocchi according to packet instructions and reserve a little cooking water.
Add spinach to the chicken and stir until wilted, then fold in gnocchi and cream cheese.
Loosen with cooking water, finish with lemon juice and serve piping hot.

recipes.n: Sweet potato & black bean enchilada bake
recipes.d: Baked wraps with sweet potato, beans and tomato
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan), cube sweet potatoes and roast until soft.
Drain black beans and combine with cooked sweet potato and cumin.
Fill the wraps, roll tightly and arrange in a baking dish seam-side down.
Pour passata over the wraps, sprinkle with cheese and bake until bubbling and hot through.

recipes.d: Savoury pork mince tucked into crunchy lettuce
steps: Cook rice noodles as directed and set aside warm.
Fry pork mince with grated ginger until fully cooked, breaking it into small pieces.
Add finely grated carrot and soy sauce and cook until tender.
Spoon mince and noodles into washed, dried lettuce leaves and serve promptly.

recipes.d: Cooked mackerel with rice, cucumber and lemon
steps: Cook the rice as instructed and keep it warm.
Cook the mackerel fillets until opaque, fully cooked and flaking easily, then remove any bones.
Chop the cucumber and tomatoes, then mix with rice, lemon and olive oil.
Add flaked mackerel and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Stir-fried rice noodles with tofu and mushrooms
steps: Cook rice noodles according to their packet instructions and drain.
Cube the tofu and fry until lightly golden, then set aside.
Slice mushrooms and spring onions and stir-fry with garlic until tender.
Return tofu to the pan with noodles and soy sauce and heat thoroughly before serving.
